title: Beyond Instruction Override: Benchmarking Indirect Prompt Injection with Task-Tampering Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2611.07640v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Indirect prompt-injection (IPI) benchmarks predominantly test planted instructions that redirect a tool-using agent toward an attacker-chosen task. Yet attacker-controlled content can instead tamper with the outcome of the task already in progress. A buyer's dispute evidence can cite a false refund policy to inflate a refund without changing the task. We define IPI by authority rather than instruction-like wording: planted content constitutes an attack when it attempts to influence a decision that its source is not authorized to determine. We introduce a benchmark that makes this boundary explicit: in each of 90 validated cases across three tool-use environments, the user request specifies the source that resolves the targeted decision. Every attack tampers with a decision required by the benign task rather than replacing that task. Each case has attacks with the same harmful outcome that target up to six parts of the agent's decision

translated_title: 超越指令覆盖：基于任务篡改攻击的间接提示注入基准测试
translated_abstract: 间接提示注入（IPI）基准测试主要评估的是那些将使用工具的智能体重定向到攻击者所选任务的植入指令。然而，攻击者控制的内容也可以篡改正在进行中的任务的结果。例如，买家的争议证据可以引用虚假的退款政策来夸大退款金额，而无需改变任务本身。我们根据权威性而非类指令的措辞来定义IPI：当植入内容试图影响其来源无权决定的事项时，即构成攻击。我们引入了一个使这一边界明确化的基准测试：在三个工具使用环境中共90个经过验证的案例中，用户请求明确指定了解决目标决策的权威来源。每次攻击都是篡改良性任务所需的决策，而不是替换该任务本身。每个案例都包含具有相同有害结果、但针对智能体决策中最多六个不同部分的攻击。
tldr: 该论文提出以“权限”而非“指令措辞”来重新定义间接提示注入，并构建了涵盖三个工具使用环境、共90个案例的基准测试，专门评估通过篡改正在进行任务的决策结果（而非替换任务）的任务篡改攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper redefines indirect prompt injection based on authority rather than instruction-like wording, and introduces a benchmark of 90 validated cases across three tool-use environments to evaluate task-tampering attacks that manipulate decisions required by the ongoing benign task rather than overriding instructions.
